subject: Audit log evidence split + bulk commit discount request
messages:
From: Megan Thompson <megan.thompson@carewellhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@carewellhealth.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Audit log evidence cadence & discount for commit tiers

Rafael — thanks for the demo earlier. We're refining our procurement ask for the compliance add-ons and I need two clarifications before we share an RFP with the legal team:

1) Evidence delivery cadence: our security team wants to know which artifacts are treated as one-time deliverables (implementation evidence, HSM attestation) vs. ongoing (monthly audit logs, retention proof). Can you provide an explicit split for what Carewell receives at onboarding vs what Redwood delivers on an ongoing basis?

2) Pricing/discounting: Carewell is considering a 12–18 month commit across multiple regions. For budgeting we need a simple matrix showing (a) commit tier (US monthly tokens), (b) discount on the compliance add-on (audit logs + KMS/HSM), and (c) whether evidence/attestation costs are absorbed or invoiced separately. We saw a few examples in the docs but nothing with combined evidence treatment + commit discounts.

If you can reply with a short table and a proposed SOW milestone schedule we can expedite with procurement by EOD Monday. Attaching a draft internal scope for visibility.

Thanks,
Megan

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit log evidence cadence & discount for commit tiers

Megan — good questions. High level answers below; I copied Tessa (pricing) and Laura (onboarding) to make sure we give procurement a firm SOW schedule. Short version: we treat attestation / HSM onboarding evidence as onboarding deliverables, and audit log access/retention as ongoing. The compliance add-on can be discounted against an overall token commit with a blended credit schedule. Details: 

--- Evidence split (onboarding vs ongoing) ---
- Onboarding (one-time, delivered within SOW milestones): HSM attestation report (if HSM selected), SOC-lite evidence bundle (implementation runbook, config snapshots), proof-of-encryption keys installed, initial auditlog snapshot ingestion (first 30 days).
- Ongoing (recurring): rolling audit log export (daily/weekly), retention attestations on request (quarterly by default), monthly ingestion metrics and a quarterly evidence pack if requested.

--- Pricing / discount matrix (illustrative) ---
- Tier A: 0–10M US tokens/month: standard compliance add-on (no commit discount). Evidence invoiced as one-time setup fee if HSM required.
- Tier B: 10–50M US tokens/month: 7% discount on compliance add-on; onboarding evidence costs credited up to 40% (split across first 6 invoices).
- Tier C: 50–200M US tokens/month: 15% discount on compliance add-on; up to 60% onboarding evidence credit; HSM attestation included for one region as a one-time credit.
- Tier D: 200M+ US tokens/month: 22% discount on compliance add-on; evidence costs fully offset across first 3 months and priority onboarding window.

Notes: discounts apply to the compliance add-on fee (audit log retention tier + KMS seat/HSM seat) and are conditional on a minimum 12-month prepaid or committed invoice cadence. We can also structure as a blended committed spend where the token commit reduces per-token unit price and the compliance add-on receives a separate percentage discount.

I attached a quick pricing-matrix spreadsheet and a draft SOW timeline for onboarding milestones. If this looks directionally right, Tessa can formalize numbers and map them to Carewell's expected US monthly token volumes.

Best,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit log evidence cadence & discount for commit tiers

Megan / team — quick follow up from pricing: Rafael's illustrative tiers are our standard starting point but two clarifications we should surface for procurement: 

1) "Evidence costs" we refer to are engineering effort to produce attestation bundles and any third-party HSM certification costs. For small pilots we invoice these as a one-time line item; for commits we apply a credit schedule (as Rafael outlined).
2) For on-prem or multi-region residency, additional per-region HSM seats have a non-linear cost curve (we price the first seat higher due to setup, subsequent seats have lower marginal price). We can show two flavors in the final matrix: (a) single-region US-only and (b) US + EU symmetric pricing.

Proposed next step: Rafael — can you confirm Carewell's expected monthly token range? Megan — if you give us a ballpark we will produce a final table with dollarized examples and amortization across the contract term.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Megan Thompson <megan.thompson@carewellhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Audit log evidence cadence & discount for commit tiers

Thanks — ballpark for calendar Q1 is ~55M US tokens/month for the primary ingestion region (US-west), with optional burst to 90M for clinical hours. We expect production cutover to happen in April, and procurement prefers a 15-month commitment window if the economics are favorable.

Two asks for the table: please show (1) a column that indicates whether onboarding evidence cost is invoiced separately vs. credited, and (2) an amortized per-month delta that procurement can paste directly into their budget sheet (i.e., how the credit reduces monthly cashflow over the first 6/12 months).

Also — can you confirm whether HSM attestation for hybrid (cloud HSM + customer HSM) is included at Tier C? If not, show the incremental fee.

Megan

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Thompson <megan.thompson@carewellhealth.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 13:50:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Audit log evidence cadence & discount for commit tiers

Megan — thanks for the ballpark. Based on 55M base (burst 90M) and 15-month preferred term, here's a concise answer (summary prior to a formal quote):

- Recommended tier: Tier C (50–200M) — you qualify for the 15% compliance add-on discount.
- Onboarding evidence: HSM attestation for a hybrid model is not fully auto-included at Tier C; we include one regional cloud-HSM attestation credit. Hybrid attestation (customer HSM + Redwood) requires a one-time validation fee: estimated $18k, or we can amortize that as a credit across the first 6 months reducing the initial cashflow.
- Amortization example (attached spreadsheet): with the Tier C discount and a $18k attestation fee amortized across 6 months, your monthly compliance line is reduced by approximately $3k/month in months 1–6 relative to invoicing the attestation up-front. Detailed dollar amounts are in pricing-matrix-commit-tiers.xlsx.

Next step: I can hand to legal/procurement — do you want us to (A) issue a term sheet + SOW with attestation fee as a credited line item, or (B) include the attestation fee as a standalone invoice and reduce the first three invoices by an agreed credit? Option A is cleaner for your AP team.

If you're good, I'll push a redlineable term sheet and DocuSign link by EOD.

— Rafael
